gates.name: Existing eXcor preserved
gates.evidence: Every change is additive to the public API; the full JVM suite and CI stay green

gates.name: Build correctness
gates.evidence: JVM tests, Android library, iOS arm64/simulator/x64 compilations and the shared metadata compile

gates.name: InnerTube operations
gates.evidence: Live: video metadata, search with filters and continuations, playlists, mixes, channels, comments, chapters

gates.name: Player compatibility
gates.evidence: PlayerJsTest passes offline; no playable player response reaches this environment
blockers: YouTube answers every client with LOGIN_REQUIRED (bot check) from this environment

gates.name: Streaming
blockers: Bot check from this environment; needs a normal-network run

gates.name: SABR/UMP
gates.evidence: Not implemented; no serverAbrStreamingUrl can be observed here
blockers: No observable SABR responses from this environment

gates.name: YouTube Music
gates.evidence: Live: search with filters and continuations, suggestions, artist pages, playlists, radio. Songs and albums are withheld from this environment
blockers: Songs, albums and discographies cannot be observed here

gates.name: Reliability
gates.evidence: Bounded bodies, cancellation, failed-tab null, per-track errors, request budgets tested offline
blockers: No end-to-end retry and backoff tests for YouTube requests yet

gates.name: Developer usability
gates.evidence: samples/jvm-quickstart installs com.excor:eXcor:0.2.0 from mavenLocal per the README and runs live

gates.name: Release packaging
gates.evidence: Full publishToMavenLocal succeeds (root, JVM, Android, three iOS klibs) and runs in CI
blockers: No remote repository or release is authorized yet

gates.name: Competitive analysis
blockers: YouTube.js and NewPipeExtractor not yet assessed

gates.name: Security
gates.evidence: URL allowlist, secret redaction in toString and logs, link destinations restricted to http(s), bounded responses
blockers: No dependency vulnerability scan in CI yet
